rationale: The assistant correctly identified the normal anti-crease phase once the customer clarified that the display showed 'End' and the drum turned intermittently, matching the hidden truth, and gave sensible reassurance about electricity use with appropriately hedged timings ('Usually it is up to around 1-2 hours'). The first turn was somewhat front-loaded, jumping to wiping moisture-sensor strips with vinegar and asking a timed-vs-automatic question the customer could not answer, rather than first clarifying what 'won't stop' meant. No fabrication, no parts, and escalation was correctly conditional on genuinely abnormal behaviour; it could have added that opening the door or unloading promptly ends the phase and that the manual covers switching anti-crease off.
